## Change / 改动

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Include screenshots at relevant sizes for UI changes.
说明解决的问题和最终行为；界面改动附对应尺寸的截图。可使用中文或英文填写。

## Validation / 验证

List executed commands, results and systems, plus untested platforms. Distinguish widget, loopback, simulator and hardware transfer tests.
列出实际执行的命令、结果和系统，注明未验证的平台；区分组件、回环、模拟器和真机互传。

## Sources / 来源

Record files, pinned versions, links and licenses for introduced or adapted third-party code or assets; update THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md. Describe AI assistance and how it was checked.
第三方代码或素材注明文件、固定版本、链接和许可，并更新第三方声明。说明 AI 辅助的范围与检查方式。

Update both English and Simplified Chinese documentation when behavior changes.
行为变化时同步更新中英文文档。
